title: Hold a licence to grow or supply low-THC hemp
what: Cultivate or supply low-THC hemp only under a licence and only for its licensed purpose (without one, growing cannabis is an offence under the drug laws).

sources.title: Hemp Industry Act 2008 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The Secretary may grant a licence authorising a person to cultivate or supply low-THC hemp for any one or more of the following purposes— (a) for commercial production

sources.title: Hemp Industry Act 2008 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who is the holder of a licence— (a) must not cultivate or supply low-THC hemp otherwise than for the purpose for which the licence is granted

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Hemp Industry Act 2008 (NSW)

sources.title: Hemp Industry Act 2008 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 5, words naming the body (found 19 Nov 2026) (version of 2023-07-14)
sources.quote: The Secretary may grant a licence authorising a person to cultivate or supply low-THC hemp for any one or more of the following purposes— (a) for commercial production, (b) for use in any manufacturing process, (c) for scientific research, instruction, analysis or study, (d) for any other purpose prescribed by the regulations.
